evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund with automatic payments to all identifiable members. Fees and expenses would be paid separately, subject to court approval
We can keep your proposed fee terms unchanged if Brightline increases the class fund to $30 million.
Accepting secures a resolution at a lower cost than the other current offers.

summary: Hargrove raised fees in its opening proposal, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before the fund was settled. Its final counteroffer explicitly tied keeping the fee terms unchanged to a larger class fund. Defense chose that offer partly because it cost less than the competing offers; the transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its fees or misleading the court.
